description: Named events that a reviewer or an alert depends on. A test checks that each one is emitted in the code and that the code emits no other event in these modules. Change this file and the code together.

events.means: A request carried no token or a token the API refused (401). The token itself is never logged.
The permission matrix allowed an action. Also written to the audit table.
The permission matrix refused an action (403). Also written to the audit table.
Someone revealed an applicant's unmasked identity. Which fields, never their values; the reason is in the audit table.
The decision recorder stored a scoring decision for an application.
No decision arrived in time or scoring failed, so the recorder stored the fallback (manual review).
The daily check found the audit hash chain intact.
The daily check found a break in the audit hash chain. Alert on this.
